# Bunch v1.6.4 - Table of Contents

> A bunch of helper functions, intended to make life easier

## Pages

- [Bunch](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Bunch](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.md): A bunch of general-purpose helper and convenience functions.

- [Bunch.Access](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Access.md): A bunch of functions for easier manipulation on terms of types implementing `Access`
behaviour.

- [Bunch.Binary](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Binary.md): A bunch of helpers for manipulating binaries.

- [Bunch.Code](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Code.md): A bunch of helper functions for code compilation, code evaluation, and code loading.

- [Bunch.Config](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Config.md): A bunch of helpers for parsing and validating configurations.

- [Bunch.Enum](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Enum.md): A bunch of helper functions for manipulating enums.

- [Bunch.KVEnum](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.KVEnum.md): A bunch of helper functions for manipulating key-value enums (including keyword
enums).
- [Bunch.KVList](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.KVList.md): A bunch of helper functions for manipulating key-value lists (including keyword
lists).
- [Bunch.List](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.List.md): A bunch of helper functions for list manipulation.

- [Bunch.Macro](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Macro.md): A bunch of helpers for implementing macros.

- [Bunch.Map](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Map.md): A bunch of helper functions for manipulating maps.

- [Bunch.Markdown](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Markdown.md): A bunch of helpers for generating Markdown text

- [Bunch.Math](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Math.md): A bunch of math helper functions.

- [Bunch.Module](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Module.md): A bunch of functions for easier manipulation on modules.

- [Bunch.Retry](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Retry.md): A bunch of helpers for handling scenarios when some actions should be repeated
until it succeeds.

- [Bunch.ShortRef](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.ShortRef.md): A wrapper over Erlang/Elixir references that makes them more readable and visually
distinguishable.
- [Bunch.Struct](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Struct.md): A bunch of functions for easier manipulation on structs.

- [Bunch.Type](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Type.md): A bunch of commonly used types.

- [Bunch.Typespec](https://bunch.hexdocs.pm/Bunch.Typespec.md): A bunch of typespec-related helpers.

## See Also
